visible_observation: The 'Reserve Tickets' action is currently positioned as a floating element in the bottom-right corner, separated from the main content block on the left. The 'Opening Hours' (Open Daily 11am - 7pm) are tucked into the bottom right footer area, visually disconnected from the location and dates.
critique: The layout fails to group essential visitor information, forcing the user to scan disparate corners of the screen to find the dates, location, hours, and ticket action. The separation of the 'Reserve Tickets' button from the exhibition details weakens the call to action and disrupts the reading flow.
revision: Move the 'Reserve Tickets' button to the left column, placing it immediately below the dates and location to create a clear, vertical hierarchy of essential information. Move the 'Opening Hours' text to the left column near the location details to consolidate all logistical data.
protected_strength: The atmospheric, high-contrast aesthetic and the abstract geometric artwork on the right must remain intact to preserve the 'immersive' and 'experimental' tone.
